message.content: {"evidence":"The original curve shows a persistent offset between J1 and J2 (indices 608–643) in all three components, and subtracting only the J1 delta over that interval restores continuity across both boundaries without distorting unrelated motion before or after; the J2 jump does not align with a return of the same magnitude/direction, and the permanent subtraction hypothesis creates a discontinuity at J2, while isolated masking leaves a sustained shifted segment.", "pair_ids":["P1"]}
